project_type: React SPA with Vite bundler and Tailwind CSS - SaaS landing page
test_framework: Build verification (vite build) - no unit tests needed for static landing page
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm run build to confirm production build succeeds. 2. Check that dist/ folder is generated with index.html and assets.
environment_constraints: Node v22 available via nvm (must source nvm.sh before using node/npm). Full internet access for npm packages.
contribution_requirements: Work on feature/saas-landing-page branch. Commit all code there.
key_patterns: React functional components with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS utility classes, Framer Motion for animations, component-based architecture with each section as its own component
directory_structure: src/ - main source with components/, assets/. Public files in public/. Config at root level (vite.config.ts, tailwind.config.js, tsconfig.json).
